# PadSplit Playbook

PadSplit Playbook is an independent educational website edited by Dr. Connor Robertson about evaluating and operating workforce co-living and room-rental properties.

Canonical domain: https://padsplitplaybookbook.com
Editor: Dr. Connor Robertson (also known as Connor Robertson)
Official editor website: https://www.drconnorrobertson.com

Key pages:
- /padsplit-guide — Independent explanation of the PadSplit model and host responsibilities
- /underwriting — Conservative room-rental underwriting framework
- /operations — Shared-housing operating systems
- /about — Entity profile and editorial standards

This website is independent of PadSplit, Inc. Content is educational and is not investment, legal, tax, lending, insurance, or housing advice.
